schema: VietlishCorpusEntry (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts) — { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
author: A10 (D4-2)
definition: Candidate Vietnamese-L1 interference items for human review before any promotion into VIETLISH_CORPUS. Each entry is a non-native English production (vietlish) paired with its natural target (natural), the VN source pattern with diacritics (sourcePattern), and a contextual sentence. A handful of entries are deliberate natural 'control' anchors (flagged in sourcePattern) so reviewers can confirm the detector abstains on natural usage.
dedupedAgainst: live 354-entry VIETLISH_CORPUS (zero string overlap), A4 d4 wave (...corpus-d4-wave-200.json, separate file), A6 !690 (selector test only)

entries.vietlish: open the music
entries.natural: turn on the music
entries.sourcePattern: mở nhạc -> mở = open, used for activating devices/media
entries.context: It is quiet, can you open the music?

entries.vietlish: open the TV for me
entries.natural: turn on the TV for me
entries.sourcePattern: mở TV -> mở = open is overgeneralised to switching on
entries.context: Open the TV for me, the news is starting.

entries.vietlish: close the air conditioner
entries.natural: turn off the air conditioner
entries.sourcePattern: tắt/đóng máy lạnh -> đóng = close is used for switching off
entries.context: I am cold, please close the air conditioner.

entries.vietlish: close the wifi
entries.natural: turn off the wifi
entries.sourcePattern: tắt wifi mapped to close instead of turn off
entries.context: Close the wifi before you sleep to save battery.

entries.vietlish: open the phone
entries.natural: turn on the phone
entries.sourcePattern: mở điện thoại -> mở = open for powering a device on
entries.context: My phone is dead, I cannot open the phone.

entries.vietlish: I hit my teeth every morning
entries.natural: I brush my teeth every morning
entries.sourcePattern: đánh răng -> đánh literally = hit/strike
entries.context: I hit my teeth every morning before work.

entries.vietlish: can you shoot a picture for us
entries.natural: can you take a picture for us
entries.sourcePattern: chụp hình -> chụp = shoot/snap mapped to shoot
entries.context: We are tourists, can you shoot a picture for us?

entries.vietlish: I want cut hair
entries.natural: I want to get a haircut
entries.sourcePattern: cắt tóc -> bare verb + missing 'get a'
entries.context: It is too long, I want cut hair this weekend.

entries.vietlish: I go up the internet to check
entries.natural: I go online to check
entries.sourcePattern: lên mạng -> lên = go up mapped literally
entries.context: I go up the internet to check the price first.

entries.vietlish: I go down the bus here
entries.natural: I get off the bus here
entries.sourcePattern: xuống xe -> xuống = go down mapped to get off
entries.context: Stop please, I go down the bus here.

entries.vietlish: eat wedding
entries.natural: attend a wedding
entries.sourcePattern: ăn cưới -> ăn = eat in the fixed phrase for attending a wedding
entries.context: This Sunday I must eat wedding of my cousin.

entries.vietlish: eat Tet
entries.natural: celebrate Tet
entries.sourcePattern: ăn Tết -> ăn = eat for celebrating the Lunar New Year
entries.context: My whole family comes home to eat Tet.

entries.vietlish: I go market every morning
entries.natural: I go to the market every morning
entries.sourcePattern: đi chợ -> bare 'go market', missing 'to the'
entries.context: I go market every morning to buy fresh food.

entries.vietlish: I will return country next month
entries.natural: I will go back to my country next month
entries.sourcePattern: về nước -> 'return country' calque
entries.context: After I finish study, I will return country next month.

entries.vietlish: I not yet eat morning
entries.natural: I haven't had breakfast yet
entries.sourcePattern: chưa ăn sáng -> 'eat morning' + 'not yet' fronting
entries.context: Wait for me, I not yet eat morning.

entries.vietlish: I have many money
entries.natural: I have a lot of money
entries.sourcePattern: nhiều tiền -> tiền treated as countable with 'many'
entries.context: Do not worry, I have many money for the trip.

entries.vietlish: I need some informations
entries.natural: I need some information
entries.sourcePattern: thông tin pluralised; 'information' is uncountable
entries.context: Before I decide, I need some informations about the course.

entries.vietlish: he gave me many advices
entries.natural: he gave me a lot of advice
entries.sourcePattern: lời khuyên pluralised; 'advice' is uncountable
entries.context: My teacher is kind, he gave me many advices.

entries.vietlish: we bought new furnitures
entries.natural: we bought new furniture
entries.sourcePattern: đồ đạc pluralised; 'furniture' is uncountable
entries.context: We just moved, so we bought new furnitures.

entries.vietlish: I have many homeworks tonight
entries.natural: I have a lot of homework tonight
entries.sourcePattern: bài tập pluralised; 'homework' is uncountable
entries.context: I cannot go out, I have many homeworks tonight.

entries.vietlish: many persons came to the party
entries.natural: many people came to the party
entries.sourcePattern: 'persons' used as the default plural of person
entries.context: It was crowded, many persons came to the party.

entries.vietlish: I cut my hairs
entries.natural: I cut my hair
entries.sourcePattern: tóc treated as countable; 'hair' is uncountable here
entries.context: It was too hot, so I cut my hairs short.

entries.vietlish: I bought two breads
entries.natural: I bought two loaves of bread
entries.sourcePattern: bánh mì counted directly; 'bread' is uncountable
entries.context: On the way home I bought two breads.

entries.vietlish: she gave me a good news
entries.natural: she gave me good news
entries.sourcePattern: tin tốt with article; 'news' is uncountable
entries.context: Call me, she gave me a good news today.

entries.vietlish: I have many works to do
entries.natural: I have a lot of work to do
entries.sourcePattern: công việc pluralised; 'work' is uncountable here
entries.context: Sorry, I cannot rest, I have many works to do.

entries.vietlish: can I have two waters
entries.natural: can I have two bottles of water
entries.sourcePattern: nước counted directly; needs a unit
entries.context: We are thirsty, can I have two waters?

entries.vietlish: I learned many knowledges
entries.natural: I learned a lot of knowledge
entries.sourcePattern: kiến thức pluralised; 'knowledge' is uncountable
entries.context: This course is good, I learned many knowledges.

entries.vietlish: there are many traffics today
entries.natural: there is a lot of traffic today
entries.sourcePattern: kẹt xe; 'traffic' is uncountable
entries.context: I am late because there are many traffics today.

entries.vietlish: I need some advices from you
entries.natural: I need some advice from you
entries.sourcePattern: lời khuyên pluralised again, very common
entries.context: You are experienced, I need some advices from you.

entries.vietlish: he has many experiences in cooking
entries.natural: he has a lot of experience in cooking
entries.sourcePattern: kinh nghiệm pluralised when meaning general experience
entries.context: Trust him, he has many experiences in cooking.

entries.vietlish: she is doctor very good
entries.natural: she is a very good doctor
entries.sourcePattern: missing article + VN adjective-after-noun order
entries.context: Go to her, she is doctor very good.

entries.vietlish: I want to be engineer
entries.natural: I want to be an engineer
entries.sourcePattern: làm kỹ sư -> missing article before profession
entries.context: After university I want to be engineer.

entries.vietlish: I like the music
entries.natural: I like music
entries.sourcePattern: thích nhạc -> overuse of 'the' for a generic noun
entries.context: In my free time I like the music.

entries.vietlish: the life is hard here
entries.natural: life is hard here
entries.sourcePattern: cuộc sống -> 'the' added to a generic abstract noun
entries.context: For new people, the life is hard here.

entries.vietlish: I go to school by the bus
entries.natural: I go to school by bus
entries.sourcePattern: đi bằng xe buýt -> 'the' added in 'by + transport'
entries.context: Every day I go to school by the bus.

entries.vietlish: he plays the football every weekend
entries.natural: he plays football every weekend
entries.sourcePattern: 'the' added before a sport
entries.context: With his friends he plays the football every weekend.

entries.vietlish: I want a rice please
entries.natural: I want some rice please
entries.sourcePattern: cơm with 'a'; rice is uncountable
entries.context: I am hungry, I want a rice please.

entries.vietlish: she is best student in class
entries.natural: she is the best student in class
entries.sourcePattern: missing 'the' before a superlative
entries.context: Everybody knows she is best student in class.

entries.vietlish: I have headache since morning
entries.natural: I have a headache since morning
entries.sourcePattern: đau đầu -> missing 'a' before headache
entries.context: I cannot focus, I have headache since morning.

entries.vietlish: the honesty is important
entries.natural: honesty is important
entries.sourcePattern: abstract noun with unnecessary 'the'
entries.context: My mother always says the honesty is important.

entries.vietlish: I bought new car yesterday
entries.natural: I bought a new car yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: missing article before a singular count noun
entries.context: I am so happy, I bought new car yesterday.

entries.vietlish: he is good father
entries.natural: he is a good father
entries.sourcePattern: missing 'a' before a singular role noun
entries.context: Everyone respects him, he is good father.

entries.vietlish: I want to make a party
entries.natural: I want to throw a party
entries.sourcePattern: tổ chức tiệc -> 'make' for organising a party
entries.context: For my birthday I want to make a party.

entries.vietlish: my family makes business in the market
entries.natural: my family does business in the market
entries.sourcePattern: làm ăn -> 'make business' instead of 'do business'
entries.context: My family makes business in the market for many years.

entries.vietlish: I must make the exam tomorrow
entries.natural: I must take the exam tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: làm bài thi -> 'make the exam' instead of 'take'
entries.context: I am nervous, I must make the exam tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: can you take a photo with your phone
entries.natural: can you take a photo with your phone
entries.sourcePattern: (control) natural collocation, keep as negative anchor
entries.context: Quick, can you take a photo with your phone?

entries.vietlish: I want to take a nap after lunch
entries.natural: I want to take a nap after lunch
entries.sourcePattern: (control) natural collocation, negative anchor
entries.context: I am tired, I want to take a nap after lunch.

entries.vietlish: let me take a coffee first
entries.natural: let me have a coffee first
entries.sourcePattern: uống cà phê -> 'take a coffee' for drinking
entries.context: Before we start, let me take a coffee first.

entries.vietlish: they will get a baby in May
entries.natural: they will have a baby in May
entries.sourcePattern: có em bé -> 'get a baby' for having a child
entries.context: Good news, they will get a baby in May.

entries.vietlish: do not say a lie to me
entries.natural: do not tell a lie to me
entries.sourcePattern: nói dối -> 'say a lie' instead of 'tell a lie'
entries.context: Look at me, do not say a lie to me.

entries.vietlish: I do sport every evening
entries.natural: I play sports every evening
entries.sourcePattern: chơi thể thao -> 'do sport' for playing sports
entries.context: To stay healthy I do sport every evening.

entries.vietlish: I can play piano a little
entries.natural: I can play the piano a little
entries.sourcePattern: chơi piano -> missing 'the' before an instrument
entries.context: At parties I can play piano a little.

entries.vietlish: I play game every night
entries.natural: I play games every night
entries.sourcePattern: chơi game -> uncountable-style 'game', missing plural
entries.context: After work I play game every night.

entries.vietlish: I play Facebook every day
entries.natural: I'm on Facebook every day
entries.sourcePattern: chơi Facebook -> 'play' for using an app
entries.context: When I am free I play Facebook every day.

entries.vietlish: I play with my phone all day
entries.natural: I'm on my phone all day
entries.sourcePattern: nghịch điện thoại -> 'play with phone' for using a phone
entries.context: My mother is angry, I play with my phone all day.

entries.vietlish: I see movie at home on weekend
entries.natural: I watch movies at home on weekends
entries.sourcePattern: xem phim -> 'see movie' instead of 'watch'
entries.context: I do not go out, I see movie at home on weekend.

entries.vietlish: he made a big progress this year
entries.natural: he made great progress this year
entries.sourcePattern: tiến bộ -> 'a big progress'; progress is uncountable
entries.context: His teacher is proud, he made a big progress this year.

entries.vietlish: I will meet you at the morning
entries.natural: I will meet you in the morning
entries.sourcePattern: buổi sáng -> 'at the morning' instead of 'in'
entries.context: Tomorrow I will meet you at the morning.

entries.vietlish: my birthday is in Monday
entries.natural: my birthday is on Monday
entries.sourcePattern: vào thứ Hai -> 'in' instead of 'on' for a day
entries.context: Come to my house, my birthday is in Monday.

entries.vietlish: I listen the teacher carefully
entries.natural: I listen to the teacher carefully
entries.sourcePattern: nghe cô giáo -> missing 'to' after listen
entries.context: In class I listen the teacher carefully.

entries.vietlish: it depend of you
entries.natural: it depends on you
entries.sourcePattern: tùy vào bạn -> 'depend of' instead of 'depend on' + missing -s
entries.context: I do not mind, it depend of you.

entries.vietlish: I am afraid with dog
entries.natural: I am afraid of dogs
entries.sourcePattern: sợ chó -> 'afraid with' instead of 'afraid of'
entries.context: Please hold it, I am afraid with dog.

entries.vietlish: we arrive to the airport at 6
entries.natural: we arrive at the airport at 6
entries.sourcePattern: đến sân bay -> 'arrive to' instead of 'arrive at'
entries.context: The flight is early, we arrive to the airport at 6.

entries.vietlish: please answer to my question
entries.natural: please answer my question
entries.sourcePattern: trả lời câu hỏi -> extra 'to' after answer
entries.context: I am confused, please answer to my question.

entries.vietlish: I ask to him about the price
entries.natural: I asked him about the price
entries.sourcePattern: hỏi anh ấy -> extra 'to' after ask
entries.context: Before I buy, I ask to him about the price.

entries.vietlish: my house is near to the market
entries.natural: my house is near the market
entries.sourcePattern: gần chợ -> extra 'to' after near
entries.context: It is convenient, my house is near to the market.

entries.vietlish: I am in the bus now
entries.natural: I'm on the bus now
entries.sourcePattern: trên xe buýt -> 'in the bus' instead of 'on'
entries.context: Call me later, I am in the bus now.

entries.vietlish: I am in house, come in
entries.natural: I'm at home, come in
entries.sourcePattern: ở nhà -> 'in house' instead of 'at home'
entries.context: The door is open, I am in house, come in.

entries.vietlish: I will call you at the afternoon
entries.natural: I will call you in the afternoon
entries.sourcePattern: buổi chiều -> 'at the afternoon' instead of 'in'
entries.context: I am busy now, I will call you at the afternoon.

entries.vietlish: I am angry to my brother
entries.natural: I am angry with my brother
entries.sourcePattern: giận anh -> 'angry to' instead of 'angry with'
entries.context: Do not ask me, I am angry to my brother.

entries.vietlish: she is married with a doctor
entries.natural: she is married to a doctor
entries.sourcePattern: kết hôn với -> 'married with' instead of 'married to'
entries.context: Now she is rich, she is married with a doctor.

entries.vietlish: yesterday I meet my old friend
entries.natural: yesterday I met my old friend
entries.sourcePattern: bare verb for past; VN has no past inflection
entries.context: What a surprise, yesterday I meet my old friend.

entries.vietlish: tomorrow I go Da Nang
entries.natural: I'm going to Da Nang tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: present/bare verb for a future plan
entries.context: Pack your bag, tomorrow I go Da Nang.

entries.vietlish: I am understanding you now
entries.natural: I understand you now
entries.sourcePattern: stative verb in continuous; VN aspect transfer
entries.context: Slow down, I am understanding you now.

entries.vietlish: I am agreeing with your plan
entries.natural: I agree with your plan
entries.sourcePattern: stative 'agree' in continuous form
entries.context: Do not worry, I am agreeing with your plan.

entries.vietlish: I live here since 2019
entries.natural: I have lived here since 2019
entries.sourcePattern: sống ở đây từ 2019 -> present instead of present perfect
entries.context: I know this area well, I live here since 2019.

entries.vietlish: I am knowing him for ten years
entries.natural: I have known him for ten years
entries.sourcePattern: stative 'know' in continuous + wrong tense
entries.context: Trust me, I am knowing him for ten years.

entries.vietlish: when I was child I very like candy
entries.natural: when I was a child I really liked candy
entries.sourcePattern: bare verb + 'very like' for past habit
entries.context: Like all kids, when I was child I very like candy.

entries.vietlish: I work here from 3 years
entries.natural: I have worked here for 3 years
entries.sourcePattern: 'from 3 years' instead of 'for 3 years' + tense
entries.context: I am not new, I work here from 3 years.

entries.vietlish: he just go out, call later
entries.natural: he just went out, call later
entries.sourcePattern: bare verb after 'just' for recent past
entries.context: Sorry, he just go out, call later.

entries.vietlish: next week I will going to Hue
entries.natural: next week I'm going to Hue
entries.sourcePattern: 'will + going' double future marking
entries.context: Buy the ticket, next week I will going to Hue.

entries.vietlish: you are from where
entries.natural: where are you from
entries.sourcePattern: VN keeps the question word in situ
entries.context: Nice to meet you, you are from where?

entries.vietlish: this is how much
entries.natural: how much is this
entries.sourcePattern: cái này bao nhiêu -> question word stays at the end
entries.context: Excuse me, this is how much?

entries.vietlish: why you are sad today
entries.natural: why are you sad today
entries.sourcePattern: no subject-auxiliary inversion in VN
entries.context: Tell me, why you are sad today?

entries.vietlish: he is doing what now
entries.natural: what is he doing now
entries.sourcePattern: VN leaves 'what' in situ + no inversion
entries.context: I am curious, he is doing what now?

entries.vietlish: you finish your homework or not
entries.natural: have you finished your homework
entries.sourcePattern: ...hay chưa -> 'or not' tag for a yes/no question
entries.context: Tell me honestly, you finish your homework or not?

entries.vietlish: you are a teacher, is right
entries.natural: you're a teacher, right
entries.sourcePattern: đúng không -> 'is right' tag calque
entries.context: I remember you, you are a teacher, is right?

entries.vietlish: I don't know where is the station
entries.natural: I don't know where the station is
entries.sourcePattern: embedded question keeps inverted order
entries.context: Can you help, I don't know where is the station?

entries.vietlish: I speak English not good
entries.natural: I don't speak English well
entries.sourcePattern: VN puts negation/adverb after the verb phrase
entries.context: Please be patient, I speak English not good.

entries.vietlish: I go always late to work
entries.natural: I'm always late to work
entries.sourcePattern: frequency adverb placed after the verb
entries.context: Sorry boss, I go always late to work.

entries.vietlish: she has a dress beautiful
entries.natural: she has a beautiful dress
entries.sourcePattern: VN adjective follows the noun
entries.context: Look there, she has a dress beautiful.

entries.vietlish: I want the car red, not blue
entries.natural: I want the red car, not blue
entries.sourcePattern: xe màu đỏ -> adjective after noun
entries.context: At the shop I want the car red, not blue.

entries.vietlish: he is enough tall for the team
entries.natural: he is tall enough for the team
entries.sourcePattern: đủ cao -> 'enough' before the adjective
entries.context: Do not worry, he is enough tall for the team.

entries.vietlish: it is too much beautiful here
entries.natural: it is so beautiful here
entries.sourcePattern: đẹp quá -> 'too much' for intensifying a positive
entries.context: Take a photo, it is too much beautiful here.

entries.vietlish: how old are you this year
entries.natural: how old are you
entries.sourcePattern: bao nhiêu tuổi năm nay -> redundant 'this year'
entries.context: May I ask, how old are you this year?

entries.vietlish: what time is it now exactly
entries.natural: what time is it now
entries.sourcePattern: redundant doubling; mostly natural but VN-flavoured
entries.context: Sorry to bother, what time is it now exactly?

entries.vietlish: please you sit down
entries.natural: please sit down
entries.sourcePattern: mời anh/chị ngồi -> 'please you' calque of the invitation marker
entries.context: Welcome to my home, please you sit down.

entries.vietlish: please you eat naturally
entries.natural: please help yourself
entries.sourcePattern: ăn tự nhiên đi -> literal calque of the hosting phrase
entries.context: The food is ready, please you eat naturally.

entries.vietlish: sorry to disturb your time
entries.natural: sorry to bother you
entries.sourcePattern: làm phiền -> 'disturb your time' calque
entries.context: Hello sir, sorry to disturb your time for a minute.

entries.vietlish: I am very sorry for trouble you
entries.natural: sorry for the trouble
entries.sourcePattern: phiền bạn -> 'trouble you' as a noun calque
entries.context: Thank you so much, I am very sorry for trouble you.

entries.vietlish: I would like to borrow your few minutes
entries.natural: do you have a few minutes
entries.sourcePattern: mượn ít phút -> 'borrow minutes' calque
entries.context: Excuse me teacher, I would like to borrow your few minutes.

entries.vietlish: best regard, Minh
entries.natural: best regards, Minh
entries.sourcePattern: trân trọng -> singular 'regard' in an email sign-off
entries.context: Looking forward to your reply. Best regard, Minh.

entries.vietlish: I hope we cooperate happily
entries.natural: I look forward to working with you
entries.sourcePattern: hợp tác vui vẻ -> literal cooperation calque
entries.context: Nice to meet you all, I hope we cooperate happily.

entries.vietlish: teacher, please teach me this
entries.natural: excuse me, could you explain this
entries.sourcePattern: thầy/cô dạy em -> over-deferential 'teach me' calque
entries.context: Sorry to interrupt, teacher, please teach me this.

entries.vietlish: auntie, how much this
entries.natural: excuse me, how much is this
entries.sourcePattern: cô ơi -> kinship 'auntie' to address a stranger vendor
entries.context: Auntie, how much this bag of mango?

entries.vietlish: uncle, can you wait me five minutes
entries.natural: excuse me sir, can you wait five minutes for me
entries.sourcePattern: chú ơi -> kinship 'uncle' + 'wait me' calque
entries.context: Uncle, can you wait me five minutes, I am coming?

entries.vietlish: I send you my deep thank
entries.natural: thank you very much
entries.sourcePattern: lời cảm ơn sâu sắc -> 'deep thank' noun calque
entries.context: For everything you did, I send you my deep thank.

entries.vietlish: looking forward to hear from you
entries.natural: looking forward to hearing from you
entries.sourcePattern: mong hồi âm -> bare infinitive after 'looking forward to'
entries.context: Please reply soon. Looking forward to hear from you.

entries.vietlish: kindly please help me check this
entries.natural: could you please help me check this
entries.sourcePattern: double politeness marker 'kindly please'
entries.context: Sorry to bother, kindly please help me check this file.

entries.vietlish: I write this email to ask you a favor
entries.natural: I'm writing to ask you a favor
entries.sourcePattern: viết email này để -> over-explicit opener
entries.context: Dear Anna, I write this email to ask you a favor.

entries.vietlish: I am normal, thank you
entries.natural: I'm fine, thank you
entries.sourcePattern: bình thường -> 'normal' for 'fine/ok' when asked how you are
entries.context: Do not worry about me, I am normal, thank you.

entries.vietlish: is 3pm comfortable for you
entries.natural: is 3pm convenient for you
entries.sourcePattern: thuận tiện -> 'comfortable' confused with 'convenient'
entries.context: Let us meet, is 3pm comfortable for you?

entries.vietlish: my brother is very fun
entries.natural: my brother is a lot of fun
entries.sourcePattern: vui -> 'fun' used as a personality adjective
entries.context: You should meet him, my brother is very fun.

entries.vietlish: please remember me to lock the door
entries.natural: please remind me to lock the door
entries.sourcePattern: nhắc tôi -> 'remember me' instead of 'remind me'
entries.context: I always forget, please remember me to lock the door.

entries.vietlish: I had a nice travel to Sapa
entries.natural: I had a nice trip to Sapa
entries.sourcePattern: chuyến đi -> 'travel' as a countable noun for a trip
entries.context: Last month I had a nice travel to Sapa.

entries.vietlish: I have many stuff to do today
entries.natural: I have a lot of stuff to do today
entries.sourcePattern: (near-control) 'stuff' is fine but watch staff/stuff mix
entries.context: Sorry I am busy, I have many stuff to do today.

entries.vietlish: the staff is very delicious
entries.natural: the food is very delicious
entries.sourcePattern: món ăn -> 'staff' for 'stuff/food' homophone slip
entries.context: Try this place, the staff is very delicious.

entries.vietlish: you are a delicious cook
entries.natural: you're a great cook
entries.sourcePattern: nấu ngon -> 'delicious' applied to the person
entries.context: I love your food, you are a delicious cook.

entries.vietlish: he is very sensible to noise
entries.natural: he is very sensitive to noise
entries.sourcePattern: nhạy cảm -> 'sensible' confused with 'sensitive'
entries.context: Please be quiet, he is very sensible to noise.

entries.vietlish: I am boring at home all day
entries.natural: I am bored at home all day
entries.sourcePattern: chán -> 'boring' for the person's feeling
entries.context: There is nothing to do, I am boring at home all day.

entries.vietlish: the price is very cheap, only expensive a little
entries.natural: the price is quite low, only a little expensive
entries.sourcePattern: rẻ/đắt mix; 'cheap' for price + odd 'expensive a little'
entries.context: Do not worry, the price is very cheap, only expensive a little.

entries.vietlish: my salary is very high than before
entries.natural: my salary is much higher than before
entries.sourcePattern: cao hơn -> missing comparative -er + 'very' for comparison
entries.context: I am happy now, my salary is very high than before.

entries.vietlish: can you on the fan
entries.natural: can you turn on the fan
entries.sourcePattern: bật quạt -> 'on' used as a verb
entries.context: It is hot, can you on the fan?

entries.vietlish: please off the light when you leave
entries.natural: please turn off the light when you leave
entries.sourcePattern: tắt đèn -> 'off' used as a verb
entries.context: Save power, please off the light when you leave.

entries.vietlish: I feel very sleepy, I want go bed
entries.natural: I feel very sleepy, I want to go to bed
entries.sourcePattern: buồn ngủ -> missing 'to' + 'go bed'
entries.context: It is late, I feel very sleepy, I want go bed.

entries.vietlish: I no understand this word
entries.natural: I don't understand this word
entries.sourcePattern: không hiểu -> 'no' as a verbal negator
entries.context: Sorry teacher, I no understand this word.

entries.vietlish: I no have time today
entries.natural: I don't have time today
entries.sourcePattern: không có -> 'no have' calque
entries.context: Maybe tomorrow, I no have time today.

entries.vietlish: yes, I am not busy now
entries.natural: no, I'm not busy now
entries.sourcePattern: VN agreement-based 'yes' to a negative question
entries.context: You ask if I am busy? Yes, I am not busy now.

entries.vietlish: no, I like it very much
entries.natural: yes, I like it very much
entries.sourcePattern: VN 'no' agreeing with a negative question frame
entries.context: You think I do not like it? No, I like it very much.

entries.vietlish: I think he will not come, isn't it
entries.natural: I don't think he'll come, will he
entries.sourcePattern: phải không -> frozen 'isn't it' tag
entries.context: The weather is bad, I think he will not come, isn't it?

entries.vietlish: must I pay now or later
entries.natural: do I have to pay now or later
entries.sourcePattern: VN modal fronting without 'do'-support
entries.context: Excuse me, must I pay now or later?

entries.vietlish: I think I cannot can come tomorrow
entries.natural: I don't think I can come tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: double modal from VN 'không thể'
entries.context: I am so sorry, I think I cannot can come tomorrow.

entries.vietlish: you should not to worry
entries.natural: you shouldn't worry
entries.sourcePattern: extra 'to' after a modal
entries.context: Everything is fine, you should not to worry.

entries.vietlish: I very want to go but I busy
entries.natural: I really want to go but I'm busy
entries.sourcePattern: rất muốn -> 'very want' + dropped 'be'
entries.context: Thank you for inviting, I very want to go but I busy.

entries.vietlish: maybe he can comes late
entries.natural: maybe he can come late
entries.sourcePattern: extra -s after a modal
entries.context: Do not wait, maybe he can comes late.

entries.vietlish: she very tired today
entries.natural: she is very tired today
entries.sourcePattern: cô ấy mệt -> dropped 'be' before an adjective
entries.context: Let her rest, she very tired today.

entries.vietlish: the weather very hot now
entries.natural: the weather is very hot now
entries.sourcePattern: trời nóng -> dropped copula
entries.context: Drink water, the weather very hot now.

entries.vietlish: have many people in the shop
entries.natural: there are many people in the shop
entries.sourcePattern: có nhiều người -> 'have' for existential 'there is/are'
entries.context: Come back later, have many people in the shop.

entries.vietlish: in my city have many tourists
entries.natural: in my city there are many tourists
entries.sourcePattern: fronted location + existential 'have'
entries.context: It is famous, in my city have many tourists.

entries.vietlish: rain very big outside
entries.natural: it's raining hard outside
entries.sourcePattern: mưa to -> dropped subject + 'big' for heavy rain
entries.context: Bring umbrella, rain very big outside.

entries.vietlish: today no have class
entries.natural: today there's no class
entries.sourcePattern: hôm nay không có -> existential 'have' negated
entries.context: You can sleep more, today no have class.

entries.vietlish: my room not have window
entries.natural: my room doesn't have a window
entries.sourcePattern: phòng không có -> 'not have' calque
entries.context: It is dark, my room not have window.

entries.vietlish: here have good coffee
entries.natural: they have good coffee here
entries.sourcePattern: ở đây có -> existential 'have' fronted by place
entries.context: Let us stop, here have good coffee.

entries.vietlish: he name is Nam
entries.natural: his name is Nam
entries.sourcePattern: tên anh ấy -> subject pronoun instead of possessive
entries.context: Let me introduce, he name is Nam.

entries.vietlish: this phone is more cheap than that
entries.natural: this phone is cheaper than that
entries.sourcePattern: rẻ hơn -> 'more cheap' instead of -er
entries.context: Buy this one, this phone is more cheap than that.

entries.vietlish: she is more tall than me
entries.natural: she is taller than me
entries.sourcePattern: cao hơn -> 'more tall' for a short adjective
entries.context: Look, she is more tall than me now.

entries.vietlish: today is the most hot day
entries.natural: today is the hottest day
entries.sourcePattern: nóng nhất -> 'most hot' instead of -est
entries.context: Stay inside, today is the most hot day.

entries.vietlish: he runs more fast than his brother
entries.natural: he runs faster than his brother
entries.sourcePattern: nhanh hơn -> 'more fast' adverb
entries.context: Watch him, he runs more fast than his brother.

entries.vietlish: I have less money than you
entries.natural: I have less money than you
entries.sourcePattern: (control) natural, negative anchor
entries.context: Let us split, I have less money than you.

entries.vietlish: this is more better for health
entries.natural: this is better for health
entries.sourcePattern: tốt hơn -> double comparative 'more better'
entries.context: Choose green tea, this is more better for health.

entries.vietlish: my house is the same with yours
entries.natural: my house is the same as yours
entries.sourcePattern: giống với -> 'same with' instead of 'same as'
entries.context: We are neighbours, my house is the same with yours.

entries.vietlish: there are too many noise here
entries.natural: there is too much noise here
entries.sourcePattern: ồn quá -> 'many' with the uncountable 'noise'
entries.context: I cannot study, there are too many noise here.

entries.vietlish: I drink too much coffees
entries.natural: I drink too much coffee
entries.sourcePattern: nhiều cà phê -> 'much' + wrong plural
entries.context: I cannot sleep, I drink too much coffees.

entries.vietlish: he is the more clever in the group
entries.natural: he is the cleverest in the group
entries.sourcePattern: thông minh nhất -> comparative for a superlative
entries.context: Ask him, he is the more clever in the group.

entries.vietlish: I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning sharp
entries.natural: I wake up at 6 every morning
entries.sourcePattern: đúng 6 giờ -> redundant 'o'clock ... sharp'
entries.context: I am never late, I wake up at 6 o'clock every morning sharp.

entries.vietlish: I stay here until 3 years
entries.natural: I have stayed here for 3 years
entries.sourcePattern: đến 3 năm -> 'until' for duration + tense
entries.context: I know this place, I stay here until 3 years.

entries.vietlish: see you again next time
entries.natural: see you next time
entries.sourcePattern: hẹn gặp lại -> redundant 'again'
entries.context: Thank you for coming, see you again next time.

entries.vietlish: I will finish in 5 minutes more
entries.natural: I'll finish in 5 more minutes
entries.sourcePattern: 5 phút nữa -> 'more' placed after the noun
entries.context: Please wait, I will finish in 5 minutes more.

entries.vietlish: two days before I called the bank
entries.natural: two days ago I called the bank
entries.sourcePattern: 2 ngày trước -> 'before' for 'ago'
entries.context: I already did it, two days before I called the bank.

entries.vietlish: after one hour later I will come
entries.natural: I will come in an hour
entries.sourcePattern: một tiếng sau -> 'after ... later' doubling
entries.context: Start without me, after one hour later I will come.

entries.vietlish: every day in the weekend I rest
entries.natural: every weekend I rest
entries.sourcePattern: cuối tuần -> 'in the weekend' + redundancy
entries.context: I am free then, every day in the weekend I rest.

entries.vietlish: I have not seen him from long time
entries.natural: I haven't seen him for a long time
entries.sourcePattern: từ lâu -> 'from long time' calque
entries.context: I miss my friend, I have not seen him from long time.

entries.vietlish: the meeting takes 2 hours long
entries.natural: the meeting takes 2 hours
entries.sourcePattern: kéo dài 2 tiếng -> redundant 'long'
entries.context: Bring water, the meeting takes 2 hours long.

entries.vietlish: I come back after 5 minutes
entries.natural: I'll be back in 5 minutes
entries.sourcePattern: 5 phút nữa quay lại -> 'after' for future 'in'
entries.context: Wait here, I come back after 5 minutes.

entries.vietlish: please give me a bill
entries.natural: can I have the bill, please
entries.sourcePattern: tính tiền -> 'give me a bill' imperative calque
entries.context: We finished eating, please give me a bill.

entries.vietlish: calculate money for me please
entries.natural: can I get the check, please
entries.sourcePattern: tính tiền -> literal 'calculate money'
entries.context: We are leaving, calculate money for me please.

entries.vietlish: I want take away, not eat here
entries.natural: I'd like it to go, not to eat in
entries.sourcePattern: mang về -> 'take away' + 'eat here' calque
entries.context: I am in a hurry, I want take away, not eat here.

entries.vietlish: one more bowl, please add for me
entries.natural: one more bowl, please
entries.sourcePattern: thêm cho tôi -> 'add for me' calque
entries.context: It is delicious, one more bowl, please add for me.

entries.vietlish: can you make the price cheaper
entries.natural: can you give me a better price
entries.sourcePattern: bớt giá -> 'make the price cheaper' calque
entries.context: I buy two, can you make the price cheaper?

entries.vietlish: I want try this clothes
entries.natural: I'd like to try on these clothes
entries.sourcePattern: thử đồ -> missing 'on' + 'clothes' number
entries.context: Excuse me, I want try this clothes.

entries.vietlish: do you have other color
entries.natural: do you have another color
entries.sourcePattern: màu khác -> 'other' for singular 'another'
entries.context: I do not like black, do you have other color?

entries.vietlish: please wrap careful for me
entries.natural: could you wrap it carefully for me
entries.sourcePattern: gói cẩn thận -> adverb form + 'for me' calque
entries.context: It is a gift, please wrap careful for me.

entries.vietlish: I want to send this to Vietnam, how much
entries.natural: how much to send this to Vietnam
entries.sourcePattern: gửi về Việt Nam -> 'how much' tag at the end
entries.context: At the post office: I want to send this to Vietnam, how much?

entries.vietlish: can you note for me the address
entries.natural: could you write down the address for me
entries.sourcePattern: ghi giúp -> 'note for me' calque
entries.context: I will forget, can you note for me the address?

entries.vietlish: I am looking, thank you
entries.natural: I'm just looking, thank you
entries.sourcePattern: tôi xem thôi -> dropped 'just' when declining help
entries.context: No need to help, I am looking, thank you.

entries.vietlish: give me one more time, please
entries.natural: could you say that one more time, please
entries.sourcePattern: cho tôi một lần nữa -> 'give me ... time' calque
entries.context: I did not catch it, give me one more time, please.

entries.vietlish: can you teach me the way to the station
entries.natural: can you show me the way to the station
entries.sourcePattern: chỉ đường -> 'teach the way' instead of 'show'
entries.context: I am lost, can you teach me the way to the station?

entries.vietlish: I am full, cannot eat more
entries.natural: I'm full, I can't eat any more
entries.sourcePattern: no rồi -> dropped subject + 'eat more'
entries.context: Thank you, I am full, cannot eat more.

entries.vietlish: the food here is very famous delicious
entries.natural: the food here is famous for being delicious
entries.sourcePattern: nổi tiếng ngon -> stacked adjectives calque
entries.context: You must try, the food here is very famous delicious.

entries.vietlish: I am very stress because work
entries.natural: I'm very stressed because of work
entries.sourcePattern: căng thẳng -> 'stress' as adjective + 'because' for 'because of'
entries.context: These days I am very stress because work.

entries.vietlish: my head is paining
entries.natural: I have a headache
entries.sourcePattern: đau đầu -> 'paining' verb calque
entries.context: Give me a moment, my head is paining.

entries.vietlish: I am fever since last night
entries.natural: I've had a fever since last night
entries.sourcePattern: bị sốt -> 'be fever' instead of 'have a fever'
entries.context: I cannot work today, I am fever since last night.

entries.vietlish: I feel cold in my body
entries.natural: I feel cold
entries.sourcePattern: lạnh trong người -> redundant 'in my body'
entries.context: Close the window, I feel cold in my body.

entries.vietlish: I am very happy in my heart
entries.natural: I'm very happy
entries.sourcePattern: vui trong lòng -> redundant 'in my heart'
entries.context: Thank you all, I am very happy in my heart.

entries.vietlish: he is sick in his head a little
entries.natural: he's a bit unwell
entries.sourcePattern: không khỏe -> 'sick in head' calque
entries.context: Be gentle with him, he is sick in his head a little.

entries.vietlish: I am hungry stomach now
entries.natural: I'm hungry now
entries.sourcePattern: đói bụng -> redundant 'stomach' calque
entries.context: Let us eat soon, I am hungry stomach now.

entries.vietlish: my eyes are tired from computer
entries.natural: my eyes are tired from the computer
entries.sourcePattern: mỏi mắt -> missing article; mostly natural, light VN flavour
entries.context: I worked all day, my eyes are tired from computer.

entries.vietlish: I lost my voice already, cannot talk
entries.natural: I've lost my voice, I can't talk
entries.sourcePattern: mất giọng -> 'already' + dropped subject
entries.context: Sorry, I lost my voice already, cannot talk.

entries.vietlish: I very thank you
entries.natural: thank you very much
entries.sourcePattern: cảm ơn nhiều -> 'very' before the verb 'thank'
entries.context: You helped me a lot, I very thank you.

entries.vietlish: how to spell your name
entries.natural: how do you spell your name
entries.sourcePattern: đánh vần thế nào -> 'how to' for a direct question
entries.context: Sorry, how to spell your name?

entries.vietlish: I think so too me
entries.natural: I think so too
entries.sourcePattern: tôi cũng nghĩ vậy -> trailing 'me' calque of 'cũng'
entries.context: You are right, I think so too me.

entries.vietlish: I will try my best to do
entries.natural: I will try my best
entries.sourcePattern: cố gắng hết sức -> redundant trailing 'to do'
entries.context: Do not worry boss, I will try my best to do.

entries.vietlish: everybody are ready now
entries.natural: everybody is ready now
entries.sourcePattern: mọi người -> plural agreement with 'everybody'
entries.context: We can start, everybody are ready now.

entries.vietlish: my english is not good much
entries.natural: my English isn't very good
entries.sourcePattern: không giỏi lắm -> 'not good much' calque of 'lắm'
entries.context: Please speak slowly, my english is not good much.

entries.vietlish: I go to there by myself
entries.natural: I'll go there by myself
entries.sourcePattern: đến đó -> redundant 'to' before 'there'
entries.context: Do not wait for me, I go to there by myself.
